mapper.select: select id, id as temp_id, title, content, time, creator_id as creatorId, creator_role as creatorRole, creator_name as creatorName, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from message order by id desc

select id, id as temp_id, title, content, time, creator_id as creatorId, creator_role as creatorRole, creator_name as creatorName, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from message where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into message(title, content, time, creator_id, creator_role, creator_name, created_at, updated_at) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{time}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorRole}, #{creatorName}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
